meta.aciklama:
A browser your AI agent can drive with plain shell commands: open a page, get a compact text snapshot, and click or fill by short refs - no screenshots, no giant page trees. In one published six-test comparison, it returned 82.5% less browser output than Playwright MCP. Free and open source (Apache-2.0). Comment BROWSER for the link.

#opensource #github #ai #free #developer

transkript.t: This open source tool gives your AI agent a browser it can control with short commands.
It's called Agent Browser from VR Cell Labs.
Your agent opens a page, gets a compact text snapshot where every element has a short
ref, then clicks and fills by ref, one command at a time.
No screenshots, no giant page trees.
In one published test, it returned over 80% less browser output than Playwright MCP.
Sessions and login state built in.
